messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary pool 'canary-east-1' reporting 37% generation errors and 4x tail latency after model promotion to 'redwood-v4.2-weightset'. Metrics: https://ci.metrics/r/abc123 - paging oncall. severity=P1 :rotating_light:
oncall-amber: I'm here, seeing the pager. Acknowledge and taking ownership. Can anyone share quick impact?
morgan.dev: Confirming - noticed bad tokens and decoding failures in the canary logs. Likely tokenizer/weight mismatch. tagging @oncall-amber and @anika.ops
anika.ops: quick dump: grep on canary logs shows repeated errors: `ValueError: unknown token id 65535 at decode` and `WeightBundleChecksumMismatch: expected 0x7f3b... got 0x2a1c...`. Also see model-config.json differs from release artifact. Pushing snippets.
---
anika.ops: ```
2026-03-15T10:04:12Z canary-3 decoder ERROR: ValueError: unknown token id 65535
2026-03-15T10:04:13Z model-loader WARN: weightset checksum mismatch expected=7f3b2d got=2a1c9d
2026-03-15T10:04:14Z router INFO: 502 from inference-worker-23
```
---
incident-bot: Noted: automated healthchecks tripped canary->rollback policy but feature-flag allowed rollout to continue. Flag: `feature.model_rollout.2026_03_v4_2` currently=ON.
morgan.dev: > feature flag is the path of least resistance here — recommend flipping kill-switch and reverting traffic. Command (internal): `rdctl feature flip feature.model_rollout.2026_03_v4_2 --env=prod --value=false`
oncall-amber: I'm going to flip the flag now. Will report back in 30s.
oncall-amber: flipped `feature.model_rollout.2026_03_v4_2` -> false :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: ACTION: feature update recorded by infra-audit (audit_id=aud-3345006795). Triggering rollback pipeline per policy.
jasper-release: Initiating rollback to `redwood-v4.1-stable` on canaries, then scale to prod targets. Rollback command: `deployctl promote --from=redwood-v4.1-stable --to=canary-east-1 --strategy=immediate`
infra-bot: ROLLBACK: Started. rollout_id=rb-3345006802. 6/6 canary pods scaled to v4.1 within 40s.
tess-cs: Observed customer reports: a few customers reported "weird characters" and truncated completion. CS ticket rate spiked ~0.8% during the window. We're sending a brief note to impacted customers.
sam-eng: quick root cause hypothesis: artifact promotion job A produced metadata pointing to weightbundle `rwd-v4.2-a` but job B concurrently updated bucket tags causing a transient mismatch. The promotion tool didn't validate final checksum if tag changed mid-promotion.
sam-eng: diagnostic diff: expected_manifest: `weightset: rwd-v4.2-a checksum: 7f3b2d`
actual_serving_manifest: `weightset: rwd-v4.2-b checksum: 2a1c9d`
morgan.dev: thanks. So basically config drift during rollout. Need to add a post-promotion integrity gate.
oncall-amber: Canary health metrics now recovering. 200/200 recent canary requests succeeded; tail-latency back to baseline. Rolling back flagged as complete.
jasper-release: Confirmed rollback complete for canary and staged prod rollback pause. Will not promote further until postmortem and fix.
tess-cs: Customer-impact summary for ops: ~8k requests affected in window 10:02-10:06 UTC. No PII exposure. Highest impact: short garbled completions and 502s. CS drafting outbound notice.
oncall-amber: Next actions: 1) eng to open postmortem ticket and link this thread 2) add integrity gate to promotion pipeline 3) add canary kill-switch automation to flip flag on healthcheck trip (currently manual). I'm handing off to @morgan.dev and @jasper-release for follow-ups. Oncall cleared in 5m.
morgan.dev: created incident board: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0315-3345 and added severity: SEV2 (customer impact, mitigated). Assigned to jasper-release for rollback follow-up and to sam-eng for pipeline fix.
jasper-release: I'll own the rollback postmortem and follow-up. Adding a short-term check: compare weight checksums before promotion and after final bucket tag settle; will add assertion to pipeline.
sam-eng: I'll spec the promotion fix and pair with anika.ops tomorrow morning.
infra-bot: NOTE: rollback completed and verified. metrics-stable=true.
oncall-amber: thanks all. Final note: kill-switch flip and rollback prevented wider impact. Handoff complete - oncall clear. :handshake:
